scenes.headline: How jevgrep walks a repository for a coding agent
scenes.sub: A yes-or-no model judges folders, files and functions, then hands over source.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gingersnap! Jev grep does a coding agent's first job for it: finding the right code. Here's how.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Jev cannot write. It answers yes or no, with a probability. jevgrep turns finding code into hundreds of those cheap answers.
scenes.say: Jev can't write. It answers yes or no, with a probability. So Jev grep asks it hundreds of those questions.

scenes.title: One walk, three kinds of question

steps.say: You ask a question. Jev judges each deeper folder from its file names alone.
Folders over one half get walked. Their files go in full, and files over a quarter are kept.
Kept files split into functions. Over a half becomes an excerpt, over a quarter a reading lead.
The agent gets one packet of verbatim source with line numbers. Nothing in it is generated.

scenes.title: The README draws the same pipeline

steps.say: The project's own graphic draws the same three steps: ask a question, Jev finds the code, the agent implements and tests.

scenes.title: What the bundled skill tells the agent
scenes.say: The bundled skill tells the agent how to use it.

items.say: Run it, scoped to the code folder.
Treat the excerpts as already read.

items.text: Fill the gaps with normal tools
items.say: Then fill gaps with ordinary tools.

left.title: The agent searches
items: Every read is re-sent on later turns
left.say: Alone, the agent pays for every read again on every later turn.

right.title: Jev searches first
items: Jev reads the repository at a tiny price
right.say: With it, Jev does the reading at a ninety-fifth of the price.

scenes.title: Ten tasks, agent bill in dollars
scenes.say: On ten tasks the agent's bill fell from seven sixty-two to four fifty-two. Counting Jev adds a dollar back, and one fewer task was solved.

scenes.text: A cheap classifier can do an agent's reading, but it only pays while the coding model is expensive.
scenes.mark: only pays while the coding model is expensive
scenes.say: Jev's bill doesn't shrink with the coding model's price, so it only pays while that model is expensive.

recap: Jev judges folders, files and functions
The agent gets verbatim source and leads
The 40% is one run, with Jev left out
scenes.say: To recap: Jev judges folders, files and functions, the agent gets verbatim source, and the forty percent leaves Jev's bill out.
